timeConvention: Frame start inclusive, end exclusive; constant mean rate for exactly one hour

sourceQuality.nativeBitmapPreserved: Original hourly bitmap retained in immutable source; six-hour replacement has valid native bitmap

provenance.source: NCEP Stage IV hourly precipitation analysis, IEM archive
provenance.spatialMethod: Nearest native cell, fixed mapping with native indices and distances retained
limitations: Historical Stage IV radar/gauge precipitation analysis, not measured rainfall at every cell or a calibrated flood prediction.
Nearest native roughly 4 km cells mapped onto a padded 0.01 degree forcing grid; finer output spacing adds no rainfall detail.
No missing-value fill, no fitted rescaling, and no blending with obsolete IEM PNG products.
Hourly constant rates omit subhour variability. This forcing does not supply upstream river inflow or downstream hydraulic boundaries.
Six-hour total is an archived analysis; uniform hourly timing is an explicit scenario assumption, not observed hourly rainfall.
This block is several days before the event, which makes coarse timing a practical antecedent scenario; its effects on storage must still be evaluated.
All other 426 frames and the preserved 96-hour event remain exactly unchanged.
No calibration to downstream flow, no automatic rescaling and no missing-to-zero fill.
